acceptance_criteria.criterion: All new code follows PHP 8.4 and project conventions per constraints.md
IndexPopulator::METADATA_KEYS is the single source of truth for index metadata field names
No logic divergence between callers (both use IndexPopulator)
Algorithm is correct: direct info.json read, infoFileExists() guard, MetadataFilter normalization
Force flag semantics are correct in all contexts (web action, CLI script, populateEntries)
Unused imports are cleaned up in refactored files
CLI script has no HTTP/session coupling
Code is clean, readable, and well-documented

summary: WP-006 is a review-only work package. Implementation was completed in WP-001 through WP-004. No code changes needed.

Code review of all 4 files (IndexPopulator.php, PopulateIndex.php, BaseComicSource.php, populate-index.php):
1. PHP 8.4: strict_types, readonly promoted param, typed const array — all correct
2. METADATA_KEYS: only in IndexPopulator, no residual lists elsewhere (grep-verified)
3. No divergence: PopulateIndex._run() = 2-line delegation, autoPopulateFromEpisodes() = 1-line delegation
4. Algorithm: info.json direct read, infoFileExists() guard, MetadataFilter::filterText() on all values
5. Force flag: web reads from request->getBool(), CLI from $argv, both pass bool to IndexPopulator
6. Imports: MetadataFilter removed from PopulateIndex & BaseComicSource; Episode retained (still used line 290)
7. CLI: zero HTTP/session refs — uses only $argv, STDOUT, STDERR, exit codes
8. Quality: comprehensive PHPDoc, clear naming, header usage docs on CLI script

Code review PASS. All 8 acceptance criteria verified through automated grep searches, PHPStan, PHPUnit, and CLI smoke tests. No issues found. Code is clean, well-structured, follows PHP 8.4 conventions, and correctly implements the plan's architectural design with IndexPopulator as the single source of truth.
